# The Great Hot Tub Hunt: Booking.com Reveals Travelers’ Most-Wanted Amenity


Summary


Hot tubs have become the most-searched amenity on Booking.com’s Smart Filter feature globally, with searches up 18%* year-on-year. To inspire travelers and make it even easier to find their perfect stay, Booking.com is spotlighting five unique hot tub accommodations around the world


Travelers are hunting for hot tubs, and Booking.com is making them easier to find. Over the past year, hot tubs ranked as the most-searched property amenity using Booking.com’s Smart Filter feature globally. The dedicated Hot Tub filter allows travelers to narrow their search to properties offering this sought-after amenity, helping them find their ideal getaway with just a few clicks. Searches using the Hot Tub Smart Filter have increased by 18%* globally year-on-year, pointing to growing demand for stays that cater to how travelers want to feel. This aligns with findings from Booking.com’s 2027


*Vibe Check(In)*


[travel predictions research](https://news.booking.com/bookingcom-2027-travel-predictions-reveal-the-ultimate-travel-flex/) , which found that 76%** of travelers would use a search tool or filter that recommends destinations based on their desired mood or how they want to feel.


European markets feature prominently among travelers searching for hot tubs. The UK leads globally by Hot Tub Smart Filter search volume, followed by the US, Italy, the Netherlands and Germany. Additionally, Booking.com’s search insights reveal that hot tub demand is strongly linked to trip duration and group type:


- **Short-Term Escapes Drive Hot Tub Demand:** The shorter the trip length, the higher the likelihood a traveler is searching specifically for a hot tub or hotel stay. Longer stays tend to skew toward apartments, pet-friendly options, and free cancellation.


- **Who is Soaking?** Hot tub searches are overwhelmingly driven by


**couples and groups** , closely followed by


**families** (for whom hot tubs are the second most-searched filter after beaches). Conversely, solo travelers rarely search for hot tubs, preferring air conditioning, balconies, and pet-friendly properties.


To bring this trend to life and inspire travelers this season,


[Booking.com](http://booking.com/) highlights five distinct hot-tub accommodations across the globe, tailored for romantic escapes, family adventures, wellness retreats, and group gatherings.


## Couples’ Weekend Retreat: Riverside Micro-Lodging in the[Scottish Highlands, UK](https://www.booking.com/region/gb/scotland.html)


Data shows that when it comes to quick escapes, the shorter the stay, the higher the demand for a hot tub - positioning scenic mini-break spots like Glencoe as ideal romantic getaways. Tucked into the landscapes of the Scottish Highlands on the Dragon’s Tooth Estate,[RiverBeds Luxury Wee Lodges](https://www.booking.com/Share-nELJpJ) features 12-square-meter wooden micro-lodges, each opening onto a private riverside terrace equipped with its own hot tub.


Couples can spend their days hiking or e-biking through mountain and riverside trails before taking a short drive to Fort William. Travelers can enhance their stay with an


[Loch Eil sunset cruise](https://booking.com/attr-YsEGD5SAVX) complete with views of Ben Nevis before returning for a night soak under the stars.


## The High-Altitude Family Hideaway: Scenic Ridge Living in[Georgia](https://www.booking.com/region/us/georgia.html) ,[USA](https://www.booking.com/country/us.html)


Hot tubs are a major priority for family getaways, ranking as the second most-searched feature for families globally, trailing only beach access. Perched above Lake Blue Ridge in North Georgia,[Aska Ridge Lodge](https://www.booking.com/Share-2wSnZGs) caters specifically to family and group trips. The four-bedroom, four-bathroom lodge sleeps up to 10 guests and includes an outdoor pool and private hot tub overlooking panoramic mountain vistas.


Inside, the property features a ping-pong games room and a private cinema room. Outdoors, guests have access to the Aska Adventure Area’s 17-mile hiking and mountain-biking trail network, as well as kayaking, tubing, and fishing on the nearby Toccoa River.


## The Couples' Escape: Historic Agriturismo in[Tuscany](https://www.booking.com/region/it/tuscany.html) ,[Italy](https://www.booking.com/country/it.html)


With Italy ranking among the top countries for hot tub filter usage globally,[Mormoraia](https://www.booking.com/Share-e3qZOgf) combines regional agriturismo heritage with private wellness. Located two miles from the medieval hill town of San Gimignano, this former convent turned agriturismo produces its own organic wine and olive oil.


Couples can opt for deluxe suites featuring private outdoor jacuzzis set on timber decks overlooking vineyards and olive groves. Guests can partake in on-site wine tastings and Tuscan cooking classes, relax by the infinity pool, or explore the UNESCO-listed historic center with a


[private tour of San Gimignano](https://booking.com/attr-kRcKzWO7aJ) .


## Duo Countryside Wellness: High-Tech Recovery in[Friesland](https://www.booking.com/region/nl/friesland.html) ,[Netherlands](https://www.booking.com/country/nl.html)


The Netherlands ranks among the top five global markets actively filtering for hot tubs.[Nest](https://www.booking.com/Share-L5ocZy) , an adults-only bed & breakfast in Luxwoude, pairs classic hot tubs and steam rooms with advanced recovery treatments such as hyperbaric oxygen therapy, full-body red-light therapy, and contrast therapy.


This tech-led approach taps into broader consumer trends: Booking.com’s 2027 Travel Predictions research indicates that 81%** of global travelers would choose a destination based on how they want to feel rather than where they want to go. With 52%** of those travelers wanting to return home feeling more relaxed. Beyond the wellness facility, guests can rent bicycles to explore Friesland’s surrounding waterways, lakes, and historic villages.


## The Alpine Group Haven: Private Saunas & Hot Tubs in[Bavaria](https://www.booking.com/region/de/bavaria.html) ,[Germany](https://www.booking.com/country/de.html)


While German travelers search for saunas more than hot tubs overall,[ZSAM Chalets](https://www.booking.com/Share-KkkspGA) bridges the gap by offering both amenities in a single property. Located at the foot of the Bavarian Alps, these three-bedroom chalets are designed for group gatherings.


Each chalet features timber interiors, a private sauna, and an outdoor heated hot tub available year-round. Guests can engage in snowshoeing and tobogganing, visit the historic Olympic Ski Stadium in Garmisch-Partenkirchen, and prepare outdoor barbecues on the private terrace.
